decisions.reason: <ref name=itis> is a <ref> tag with content inside {{Reflist|refs=}}; 3.2 lists each such tag as a use, and as the first definition it binds to itself (u4 locked correctly). Its render_ref_id null is right: the render has exactly three mw:Extension/ref markers (cite_ref-itis_1-0, cite_ref-gbif_2-0, cite_ref-buglink_3-0), all from the self-closing body calls, so the list definition produces no marker of its own.
Same as item 0: <ref name=gbif> inside {{Reflist|refs=}} is a content-bearing <ref> use binding to itself; no marker of its own (only cite_ref-gbif_2-0 exists, from the self-closing body call).
Same as item 0: <ref name=buglink> inside {{Reflist|refs=}} is a content-bearing <ref> use binding to itself; no marker of its own (only cite_ref-buglink_3-0 exists, from the self-closing body call).
